verdict.rationale: ADK ships an official `adk` CLI. Its GitHub README documents `adk run`, `adk web`, `adk eval` and `adk deploy docker`/`cloud_run`, and the docs reference `adk api_server`. The docs also describe an Agents CLI that can be driven from AI-enabled developer environments to scaffold, build, test, evaluate and deploy agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-friendly CLI ergonomics such as machine-readable or JSON output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
Migrate existing agents and workflows to ADK with Agents CLI.
